description: For an empty domain \(A\), there is exactly one function assigning to each \(a\in A\) a value in a specified type \(B(a)\). In particular, there is exactly one map \(\varnothing\to B\) for any fixed codomain \(B\).
signature: Pi.uniqueOfIsEmpty.{v, u_1} {α : Sort u_1} [IsEmpty α] (β : α → Sort v) : Unique ((a : α) → β a)
